senses.gloss: f. (v. קְרוּם); ק׳ של קנה (or sub. של קנה) the skin-like, scaly envelope of reed, haulm (used as knife, v. Löw, Pfl. p. 344).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 1:5">Tosef. Ḥull. I, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 15b:9">Ḥull. 15ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>בכל … בק׳ וכ׳</he> you may cut ritually with any tool, … with glass or with a reed haulm.

<cite ref="Chullin 57b:6">Ib. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>עשו לה ק׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>קרומין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) they prepared for it (to be inserted in the perforated windpipe) the haulm (ed. haulms) of reed, and the animal recovered.—Pl. <he>קְרוֹמִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> (used as sing.); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:6:5">Y. Sabb. VIII, end, 11ᶜ</cite> <he>קלומות</he> (corr. acc.).—Pesik. B’shall. p. 87ᵃ <he>שהיו נותנים … וק׳ של קנה וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>וקולמיות</he>, corr. acc.) they put glowing iron balls under their armpits, and drove pieces of reed under their nails; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 667:3">Yalk. ib. 667</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7:1">Cant. R. to II, 7</cite> <cite ref="S01999"><he>קרטיות</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 125a:2">Sabb. 125ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ של מחצלת</he> shreds of reeds detached from mats.
